## What this letter says
You have an appointment for a heart scan (echocardiogram).
This is an ultrasound scan of your heart.
The scan takes about 45 minutes.

## What you need to do
1. Go to your scan on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 10:40.
2. Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time.
3. Bring a list of all the medicines you take.
4. You do not need to fast before this test.
5. You do not need to stop any of your medicines.
6. If you cannot go, call 01632 960 123. Call at least 48 hours before the appointment.

## Dates and medicines
- Heart scan (echocardiogram): Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 10:40.
- Place: Cardiac Investigations Unit, Level 2, Northbridge General Hospital.
- The letter does not list any medicines or changes to medicines.
- You do not need to stop any of your medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does "fast" mean for this test?
- What will happen during the scan?
- How will I get my results?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
